answer: Call it rate-limited nullifier. Each vote mints a nullifier from the stake. A haven registry stores spent nullifiers per epoch, so the second use is provably the second use. The reveal is one-way, so the voter stays anonymous while the ripple penalty lands on the stake. A nectar tally counts reveals per funder, and a third reveal freezes every identity that funder sponsored. The attacker pays: 7874 identities cost 1896 paid peers, 203306 tokens of stake and 17030 dollars. Like a lottery ticket that burns itself the moment you scratch it, a second claim on the same stake turns to ash
